title: Priority Places for Food Index by council: small areas in each nation's highest-priority deciles
coverage: All 361 UK councils: 43538 small areas (three domains without data in Northern Ireland)
attribution: Priority Places for Food Index v2.1, Healthy & Sustainable Places Data Service (HASP) / CDRC, DOI 10.82147/003 (OGL v3.0). Source: Office for National Statistics licensed under the Open Government Licence v.3.0

retrieval.method: Derived offline from the committed index (provided by John) and the official lookups
retrieval.notes: Counts of small areas per council, as published deciles; shares and within-nation ranks are computed in the app. Scotland's index uses 2011 Data Zones.
